title: Philippe Groffey (?) to Ferenc Rákóczi II (Pompeio Cesoni), 15 October 1707 (DECODE R902)

steps.what: Read the clear address A Monsieur / Monsieur Pompeio Cesoni.
Located and applied DECODE R639, Fasc. 44/08, headed De Monsieur de Bonac et Graffei.
Validated the key on same-series known-plaintext documents R852 and R912.
Recovered 1,020 of 1,108 transcribed groups and read the report in substance.
Attributed the unsigned report to Philippe Groffey from the key heading, subject, and diplomatic role.

Transcribed p. 278 lines 10-18 (DECODE image 4844) afresh from the image, 196 groups (tr/R902_p278_l10-18.txt), and decoded them with the corrected R639 table (decode_tr.py): every non-filler group has a value and the passage reads continuously (R902_p278_reading.md): the Swedes complain of Rakoczi's remark that he would sacrifice himself to free Polish liberty 'opprimee par les Suedois en faveur du Roy Stanislas'. DECODE's 3^ is this hand's 5; its real slips are 1 read as 2 and a few figures (527 Tekeli for 517 Hongrie). Added 212 = Fa, 93 = st and the rule that an underlined number keeps its first syllable (grade C).

Transcribed p. 277 (31 lines) and p. 278 lines 1-9 group by group from the images (tr/R902_p277.txt, tr/R902_p278_l01-09.txt); found the curled 'c' figure is 1 (DECODE's 27x are mostly 17x) and DECODE's '1 o 4' is often 109. The letter now reads continuously: dated Slupca 15 October, Swedish army 8 leagues from Poznan, Raday's letters to Rehnskiold, rumour of arrests of the Palatine of Ruthenia's children.
Added 89 = Et (three places, gap between 88 M and 90 N) and 12 context-forced one-figure corrections (118 es for 128, 298 ni for 248, etc.), grade C.

Measured with measure_tr.py over all three transcription files, fillers excluded, line-initial 121/129 counted unread: 982/1017 = 96.6% read as sense; p. 277 l. 13-14 (10 groups) and ~25 scattered groups stay unread.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The key is DECODE R639 (MNL OL G15 Caps. C Fasc. 44/08, 'De Monsieur de Bonac et Graffei'), a separate key record not tied to R902, found by scoring NAH G15 keys and applied to DECODE's digit transcription (1,020 of 1,108 groups); validated on the same-key comparators R852 and R912.

gaps.item: R902 p. 277 l. 13-14, end of first paragraph (10 groups)
gaps.detail: clearly written groups decode to letters that form no word (gi les de gu O pe avec U); no sibling or print to check
re-read on the image; value gives no sense in context

outcome.fraction_read_source: measure_tr.py over tr/R902_p277.txt, tr/R902_p278_l01-09.txt, tr/R902_p278_l10-18.txt (fresh image transcription): 982 of 1,017 counted groups read as sense; fillers excluded; listed UNREAD groups and unvalued groups count as unread.
outcome.notes: Whole letter retranscribed from the images (30 Sept, 5 Oct 2026) and read: R902_reading.md. 12 grade-C context corrections plus 89 = Et. Earlier 0.92 was a has-a-value count over DECODE digits.

human: Supplied access to the authenticated DECODE session and posed the target.
